leadText: Volume 3 is the third volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and were collected in the regular volumes once the had finished.
plainText:
Volume 3 is the third volume published by Shogakukan compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and were collected in the regular volumes once the had finished. 

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Dancing Vivillon
Burning Fletchinder
Shooting Frogadier
Gathering Klefki
Tying Trevenant
Changing Gengar
Surrounding Braixen

==Important events==
 

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
X's "Garma" in PS575.

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Y's "Fletchy" evolves into in PS571.
Y's "Croaky" evolves into in PS572.
